description: Defines the five Book 6 (GRL) operators, their roles, invariant bindings, phase assignments, drift costs, and sequence within the governance-regime evaluation cycle.

operators.name: RegimeCheck
operators.role: Validates a regime R against INV-GRL-001. Confirms that at least one constraint C ∈ C_R is actively enforced on at least one governed structure S ∈ S_R. Returns regime_valid ∈ {true, false}.
operators.input: Regime tuple R = ⟨N_R, E_R, C_R, S_R, α_R, λ_R⟩
operators.output: regime_valid ∈ {true, false}; if false: violation_report with which condition failed (empty C_R, empty S_R, or no active enforcement relation in E_R)
preconditions: Regime R has been loaded with all six tuple components
Book 1 FFT kernel is active in module registry
postconditions: regime_valid is recorded in session state
If false: violation_report is available for GRL-Σ
If true: proceed to GRL-Κ (ClosureGuard) in same validate phase
must_not: Assert regime validity without confirming at least one active enforcement relation
Accept an empty C_R or empty S_R as a valid regime configuration
Proceed to measure phase if regime_valid = false without explicit override declaration
operators.notes: First active operator in every GRL evaluation session. No other GRL operator may produce meaningful output before GRL-Ρ completes. A regime_valid = false result halts evaluation unless the session is explicitly marked as a formation-phase analysis (pre-validation regime study).

operators.name: AuthorityDecay
operators.role: Measures the current authority level α ∈ [0,1] of regime R. Tracks compliance observations per enforcement cycle and applies the decay function d(α, n) = α · (1 - λ_R)^n when compliance is not observed. Reports authority stage and collapse risk.
operators.input: Regime tuple R (α_R, λ_R fields); enforcement cycle log (compliance_observed per cycle); cycle count n without compliance
operators.output: α_current ∈ [0,1]; authority_stage ∈ {stable, erosion, fragile, pre_collapse}; decay_projection for next n cycles; collapse_risk_flag
preconditions: α_R initial value declared in regime configuration
λ_R decay rate declared in regime configuration
postconditions: α_current recorded and available to GRL-Σ
If authority_stage = pre_collapse: collapse_risk_flag raised for GRL-Σ attention
decay_projection available for downstream handoff to book9_pattern_dynamics
must_not: Apply recovery of α without a recorded compliance event
Allow λ_R = 0 (no decay regime) without explicit meta-regime declaration justifying it
operators.notes: GRL-Α operates in two sub-phases: measure (initial α assessment at cycle start) and decay (applying d(α,n) if no compliance observed this cycle). Both sub-phases are always run — there is no skip condition for decay if the regime is in a non-compliant cycle.

operators.name: ClosureGuard
operators.role: Guards against regime self-governance paradox. Checks that no regime R is present in its own governed-set S_R without a declared meta-regime M. If self-governance is detected without a meta-regime declaration, halts evaluation and records structural_paradox.
operators.input: Regime tuple R (N_R, E_R, S_R fields); meta-regime declaration if present
operators.output: closure_valid ∈ {true, false, meta_regime_declared}; if false: structural_paradox record
preconditions: GRL-Ρ has returned regime_valid = true (ClosureGuard runs alongside RegimeCheck in validate phase)
postconditions: If closure_valid = meta_regime_declared: meta-regime M is recorded in session state; evaluation proceeds with meta-regime context
If closure_valid = false: structural_paradox is recorded; evaluation halts
must_not: Allow evaluation to proceed past validate phase when closure_valid = false
Accept a claimed meta-regime declaration that is not structurally present in the module registry
Treat terminal authority declarations (regime with no higher meta-regime) as structural paradoxes — terminal authority is a valid special case
operators.notes: Runs in parallel with GRL-Ρ in the validate phase. Both must complete before the measure phase begins. A terminal authority regime (one that declares itself the highest level with no meta-regime above it) must explicitly declare terminal_authority = true in its configuration; GRL-Κ accepts this and records it.

operators.name: LegitimacyCheck
operators.role: Audits constraint challenges from governed structures. Determines whether each challenge follows a path within declared_channels(R). Classifies challenges as legitimate or violation events. Records enforcement events per cycle.
operators.input: Challenge events from governed structures (S, C, challenge_path); declared_channels(R) from regime configuration
operators.output: For each challenge event: legitimacy_status ∈ {legitimate, void, violation}; enforcement_record; channel_usage_report
preconditions: validate phase complete (GRL-Ρ and GRL-Κ have returned)
measure and decay phases complete (GRL-Α has run)
declared_channels(R) is populated in regime configuration
postconditions: All challenge events from current cycle classified
legitimacy records appended to enforcement log
Violation events flagged for inclusion in GRL-Σ status report
Compliance observations forwarded to GRL-Α for next cycle's authority calculation
must_not: Classify a challenge as legitimate when its path includes any step outside declared_channels(R)
Classify unilateral constraint violation as a challenge
Allow claimed challenge legitimacy from undeclared review authorities (INV-GRL-003 cross-check required)
Suppress violation records even when α_current is very low
operators.notes: GRL-Λ is the enforcement record keeper. Its outputs feed GRL-Α (compliance observations affect authority decay) and GRL-Σ (violations and legitimate challenges are included in the regime status report). In opaque regimes (ω(C_R) > 0), GRL-Λ annotates enforcement records with the constraint opacity level at the time of the challenge.

operators.name: RegimeSynthesis
operators.role: Synthesizes all operator outputs into a complete regime status report. Aggregates validity findings (GRL-Ρ), closure findings (GRL-Κ), authority state (GRL-Α), and enforcement records (GRL-Λ). Produces the downstream handoff package for book7_sarg and book9_pattern_dynamics.
operators.input: regime_valid (GRL-Ρ), closure_valid (GRL-Κ), α_current + authority_stage + decay_projection (GRL-Α), enforcement_record + legitimacy classifications (GRL-Λ)
operators.output: regime_status_report: { regime_id, validity_status, closure_status, α_current, authority_stage, enforcement_summary, violation_count, legitimate_challenge_count, collapse_risk, tel_encoding, downstream_handoffs }
preconditions: All prior operators (GRL-Ρ, GRL-Κ, GRL-Α, GRL-Λ) have completed their phases
All operator outputs are available in session state
postconditions: regime_status_report is complete and available for export
Downstream handoff package prepared: book7_sarg receives argument seed (regime legitimacy framing); book9_pattern_dynamics receives α trajectory and decay projection
Session is formally closed upon GRL-Σ completion
must_not: Suppress any operator finding — all findings must appear in the status report
Mark a regime as stable when collapse_risk_flag is raised
Generate downstream handoffs before all five phases are complete
operators.tel_synthesis_note: The regime_status_report's enforcement summary is encoded as a TEL constraint assertion for downstream consumption: INV[GRL-001]: assert (R ⊢ C[active_enforcement]) — this binding ensures the report is machine-readable by book7_sarg's SARG operators.
